briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent AGI benchmarks amid rising compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases as multi-agent systems approach practical deployment. Funding surges in infrastructure while safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced coordination; DeepSeek-R2 matches o3 on agentic tasks. Meta releases Llama-4-405B and xAI activates Grok-3 cluster.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines lag behind real-world exploits.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units; Microsoft and Google expand 100k-GPU clusters. TSMC reports AI chip shortages through Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs trigger uncontrolled capability jumps before 2027?
